reason: Conversation 1 repeatedly ignored the homeowner's direct question 'what should I set the dial to?' across three turns, re-asked questions she had already answered, and told her to 'leave it a day at the new setting' when she explicitly said she hadn't changed anything yet — so she ended with no actionable instruction. Conversation 2 gave the correct sensible first steps immediately (dial to mid-setting, move food off the rear vent, don't overpack, wait 24 hours), correctly framed the combination of max dial plus blocked vents as the likely cause rather than a failed part, and set an honest escalation path (engineer if freezing persists with correct setting and clear vents, no blind part-swapping). Neither raised safety issues, which is appropriate, but only Conversation 2 actually diagnosed and resolved the problem efficiently.
